notes.title: I think I found out why Woof Blaster is not working for some people

notes.title: I have made the game free
notes.notes:
I have asked Valve for Woof Blaster to be free.

Thanks for everyone who has paid for it.

I'm not sure why it's not appearing in the library for some and why it is still listed as priced.

I have just emailed Valve and I will make a new post when they get back to me.
